Hey, look over there.
Hayahide-san is talking about something crazy complicated.

...Being described as "amazing" feels unnatural to me.
That word implies something "extraordinary," after all.

Certainly, to an onlooker, proceeding through pure logic
might seem like quite a formidable task. However...

Biwa Hayahide has honed her own unique weapon through sheer effort.
I told her there's no doubt that makes her truly incredible.

I mentioned earlier that number 4 is our key rival,
but please refer to her data over the past three races. In other words—

Indeed. I will polish this weapon even further, and with you,
I will overcome this fierce competition. My resolve remains unchanged.

Yet throughout the rest of the meeting,
Biwa Hayahide would occasionally appear lost in thought—

Whoa, you're right. She really is one of the top geniuses in our year.
She's so amazing... She's on a completely whole 'nother level.

Her theories were as sophisticated as ever, and I could barely keep up.
As I frantically took notes so as not to fall behind...
...Thank you.

No... never mind.
Now, let us continue our meeting.

Therefore, the word "amazing" ought to be reserved
for an Umamusume blessed with natural, innate genius.

Formulas must be verified swiftly. Otherwise,
should there be an error, our recovery would be delayed.

One day, during a strategy meeting
with Biwa Hayahide for her next race...

An ordinary girl like me simply had no other choice but to arm myself with logic.
Without it, I wouldn't have even been admitted to this academy.
—Even after leaving the cafeteria, a shadow of gloom lingered on her face.

Watching Biwa Hayahide walk ahead as if driven by some unseen pressure,
I found myself wondering how I could help her find true confidence.

Having such a prodigy for a younger sister might give her complex feelings
that no outsider could ever understand. But—even so.

—Based on the figures above, we can anticipate this race will tilt
toward a front-running pace. Now, let us review the opposing runners once more.

Most likely, she was thinking of
her sister—the "Monster," Narita Brian.

To yearn for raw talent, something beyond the reach
of effort... even I find myself exasperated by such foolishness.

What do you even do to get that smart?
Do I just need to study non-stop or something?

No, forgive my pointless rambling. After this... though it isn't on the schedule,
I would like to conduct some training based on our meeting.

People like her are just built different from the start!
There's no way we could ever pull that off~.
..."Amazing," is it?

...! No... you are right, my apologies.
It's nothing of real consequence.

Looking at Biwa Hayahide gazing into the distance, a fleeting lack of confidence
was unmistakable. Even she, ever so composed, had her vulnerable moments.

Still, Trainer... I must confess,
as an older sister... I simply wished to be superior.
